record.office: Secretary of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania
record.t: Was appointed by Governor Josh Shapiro as Acting Secretary of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania on Jan. 17, 2023, and officially became Secretary on June 29, 2023. (2023).
record.q: Gov. Josh Shapiro appointed Al Schmidt as Acting Secretary of the Commonwealth on Jan. 17, 2023, and Schmidt officially became Secretary on June 29, 2023.

record.t: Took office as Secretary after the Senate did not act on his nomination within 25 legislative days.
record.q: Pursuant to Pennsylvania Constitution Article IV Section 8b, Schmidt took office after the Senate did not act upon his nomination within 25 legislative days.

record.t: Served for 10 years as a Philadelphia City Commissioner and was vice chairman of the three-member bipartisan Board of Elections.
record.q: Before that, Schmidt served for 10 years as a Philadelphia City Commissioner, where he was vice chairman of the three-member bipartisan Board of Elections.

record.t: Began weekly press briefings covering topics leading up to Election Day, with the first focused on mail ballot voting.
record.q: Sec. Schmidt also began weekly press briefings this week that will cover a variety of important topics leading up to Election Day.
